Proposed Green Data Centre and Relocation of Green Space

summary: Proposed c. 212.4 MW hyperscale 'green' data centre by Shelborn Drummond Ltd (Shelborn Asset Management group) on the 5.74 ha former RBS headquarters site at 1 Redheughs Avenue, South Gyle/Edinburgh Park, Edinburgh. Planning permission in principle (25/04239/PPP) for a two-building campus was refused unanimously by City of Edinburgh Council in February 2026. Shelborn appealed (DPEA PPA-230-2794). A 30 July screening direction required an Environmental Impact Assessment and the appellant confirmed on 12 August that it would submit an EIA Report. Scottish Ministers recalled the appeal on 17 August; the DPEA case is now on hold for ministerial consideration, with a revised target date of 28 September 2026. This is the highest-profile Scottish data centre refusal case to date.
maturity_explanation: Formal application for planning permission in principle 25/04239/PPP (dated 18 August 2025, per DPEA) was validated and determined: refused by City of Edinburgh Council on 9 February 2026 following the committee's unanimous vote on 4 February 2026 against officer recommendation. Appeal PPA-230-2794 was received by DPEA on 31 March 2026. Scottish Ministers recalled the appeal on 17 August 2026 and it remains live but on hold for ministerial consideration, rather than being a lapsed scheme.

latest_development.headline: Scottish Ministers recall appeal PPA-230-2794; DPEA marks the case on hold with a revised target date of 28 September 2026, after the appellant confirms it will submit an EIA Report
